agent-manifest.description: Deterministic shrubbery market (Roger the Shrubber): lists shrubberies with a niceness rating and a price, and judges whether a chosen one is acceptable for a knight — nice enough AND within the knight's budget. It sells shrubberies; it grants no passage.

offer.body: The available shrubberies (name, niceness, price) and a judgement of a chosen shrubbery's acceptability for the knight: niceness at or above the bar AND price within the knight's budget.
Acceptability is judged against the knight's own budget in code — "not too expensive" is enforced, not eyeballed.

use.body: Reads the verified knight's shrubbery budget to judge acceptability.
